item.title: First thoughts after watching Classroom of the Elite Season 4 Episode 13
item.description:
I am a light novel reader for this series and this note includes a spoiler.

I watched the Classroom of the Elite, COTE, season 4, episode 13. I finally liked Amasawa in Anime. I didn't do in LN so much, but with watching animation for her, she is an emotional and mysterious girl, and that's nice.

Anyway, Amasawa came to Ayanokoji and Nanase's fighting place. At first, Nananse didn't trust her at all because she saw someone with hair like Amasawa back when Kinoshita was hit by the cliff. Well, it makes sense. Who can trust her? Then she talked to Ayanokoji alone and revealed herself that she was from the White room. And then she left. Why did she come to him? I had no idea, but probably shouldn't think. If I remember correctly, it was not that important. Perhaps because she came near him and couldn't stop meeting with him and talking about herself.

Then, Ayanokoji left Nanase to Housen, and then he was trying to reach out to Sakayanagi while taking an exam. He met Ibuki, who doesn't like the support from him, and also met Kiryuin. Actually, Kiryuin's scene was hilarious. It was a way better than I remembered, because an emotion less Ayanokoji was confused with how she reacted with his joke. She is basically a Koenji in 3rd year grade as a woman.

Then he met with Shiranami or some sorts. I forgot who she was but she was the person in Ichinose's class and talked about the relationship between Ichinose and him. It was very short conversation. Probably there was more in a LN, or maybe because there is talking in themselves that were not animated. I think the important thing here is that they had a transceiver which he and Horikita discussed in this episode, and used it to talk with Sakayanagi.

The later part of an exam is about to begin, and it's going to be more interesting than the earlier part.

item.title: First thoughts after watching Classroom of the Elite Season 4 Episode 12
item.description:
I am a light novel reader for this series and this note includes a spoiler.

I watched the Classroom of the Elite, COTE, season 4, episode 12. This episode was about 2 things. First, the Nanase finally lured Ayanokoji into a place where nobody is there and started fighting against him. When I watched in English Dub, it's a little bit hard to understand when she tried to behave like.. what is his name? Eiichiro? But fighting scene was a good that Ayanokoji is as expectedly overwhelming her. I still don't feel this scene and the motivation of Nanase doesn't really make sense, but she is 15 or 16 so make sense that she wants to put someone for her anger.

The another scene is, behind the scene of Ayanokoji and Nanase, Kushida was trying to take a picture of them, so they can expel him. She was asked by Yagami, so he showed he outsmarted her completely. However, Amasawa found her and obviously she couldn't deal with Amasawa at all. Her physique is, as usual, extraordinary, and showed, what was that? Judo? so Amasawa even throw her. With this physique and her obsession to Ayanokoji, which seems even crazy, it's so obvious that she is from the White room, but for readers, they don't know why she didn't try him to get expelled.

The final scene was Ichinose, who happen to find the secret conversation to kick out Ayanokoji between Tsukishiro and a man, and she was intimidated not to tell what she heard. Ichinose is treated like one of the main heroine here instead of Horikita. Well, I know what's going to come, so I wouldn't say that much.

This episode has a little action and also reveal a little truth so it was a good one.

item.title: First thoughts after watching Classroom of the Elite Season 4 Episode 11
item.description:
I am a light novel reader for this series and this note includes a spoiler.

I watched the Classroom of the Elite, COTE, season 4, episode 11. Overall, finally a story started getting interested in.

The episode started from the scene that alarms were going off without stopping and then Ayanokoji, Nanase, Ike, and others found out they're from Komiya's one. They knocked out and was unconscious, and they found out they were falled from the cliff, but Shinohara wasn't there who was supposed to be the same group as Komiya. Then after that, Ike tried to find and found out Shinohara above the cliff, who hid because she saw somebody kicked Komiya and pushed them down, and she was scared, which is actually pretty scary if you're only one person out there in a dark, and someone would kick you but you don't know why they do. Then teachers somehow didn't believe Shinohara and they sent two students away from the exam.

The rest of the episode is somehow, related to this incident. One is that Nanase somehow started running and found someone, who looks obviously Amane, but Amane didn't stop and Nanase even couldn't catch up to her. Then Ike tried to be cool and started working together with Shinohara. Ayanokoj was trying to get a help from Ryuen, Sakayanagi, and Ichinose for Shinohara, obviously, by something. I honestly don't remember what it will be. Ask Shinohara to join a group of... which? Sakayanagi, but then talking to Ryuen for... helping his class, too? One scene it was cut from LN was that why Sakayangi is there. Obviously, Sakayangi couldn't move but she was exempted from joining each exam in the island and still can get a point, but there was no such small talk.

While Ayanokoji was trying to find them, they also met Koenji, who was the 4th in the rank. There is a little interaction with them, but not so many animation. I hope they will have in the exam later.

item.title: Brain dump after watching Classroom of the Elite Season 4 Episode 10
item.description:
I am a light novel reader for this series and this note includes a spoiler.

I watched the Classroom of the Elite, COTE, season 4, episode 9. First of all, this episode showed that Ayanokoji cannot become a weeb. That's most important thing in the episode.

Throughput this episode, it's good to see the animation of what's happening in this exam, especially it's hard to think what happens. Some history quiz or the anime quiz on the beginning is obvious, but the scene where Nanase took a rest was just on a few rocks without any water in a forest, for example. Why didn't find a place to drink water there. Also, it was great that Sudo didn't believe Nanase as he saw what she had done.

In the other scene, then Ayanokoji kissed Karuizawa. That scene doesn't show Ayanokoji's eyes at all so it's... scary what he thinks. Probably no face change, though, contrary to Karuizawa's blushed face.

What Nagumo did was something I didn't get and also forgot. He did something but... what was it in the LN?

item.title: Brain dump after watching Classroom of the Elite Season 4 Episode 9
item.description:
I am a light novel reader for this series and this note includes a spoiler.

I watched the Classroom of the Elite, COTE, season 4, episode 9. I may already remember scenes incorrectly throughout this series, or maybe an anime changed the original script. For example, there was a short scene of Nanase's past. How did Ayanokoji involve with someone outside of Whiteroom? Or maybe did this scene try to show Nanase was actually related to the Whiteroom? Also, somehow, Horikita knew that Ayanokoji and Kushida had a deal so he needs to give points. I remembered this was far later than this episode is, so I'm not really sure the intent is here.

As for the episode, at last, the new exam started. Tsukishiro's announcement that some amount of violences are allowed sounds really terrible here. And even no other teachers did not complaint or stop him, so that is very much like that school.

Then the island itself is very big and where Ayanokoji went in this episode is really in a jungle. It's really great way to show on the anime and it also shows that there is really a risk. A wrist for health checks and warnings really isn't enough in that size of the island honestly. I forgot how the island's exam when they were on the 1st year was, but now thinking about this exam, the jungle is so big and this exam looks so anime size. Well, cruise is also really big.

item.title: Watching Classroom of the Elite Season 4 Episode 7
item.description:
I am a light novel reader for this series and this note includes a spoiler.

I watched the Classroom of the Elite, COTE, season 4, episode 7. It was on the April til the episode 5, and on the episode 7, it got on July. I felt this season skipped a volume from the light novel, but I don't remember what it was even if it was.

Anyhow, in this episode, it's mostly about how 1st grade prepared next exam in an island. I think there were 2 main characters in this episode, Yagami and Housen, and they were contrary. Housen is obviously the main from the 1st year grade but Yagami also tried to group the 1st year together to fight against other years. At least from the acting and character design, he looks smart, kind, and thoughtful person.

The interesting character in the anime is Tsubaki. She was sucking her candy while Ayanokoji and a guy was talking, and suddenly she chewed it and the sound of chewing is loud enough while other 2 guys were talking. Probably going forward, she will always do the same thing as this is her character.

item.title: Watching Classroom of the Elite Season 4 Episode 6
item.description:
I am a light novel reader for this series and this note includes a spoiler.

I watched the Classroom of the Elite, COTE, season 4, episode 6. In the end of the last episode, Chabashira taught them there will be next exam, and it was going to be the biggest exam. This episode is whole about that preparation before that exam. Koenji may have a problem but he isn't worried at all and planned to do something. Ike had a crash on Shinohara but he couldn't ask her to join to a group on the next exam and she somehow joined with guys in the class B. Ike was actually pretty good at surviving in an island, which he showed in the last year, so that's why Ayanokoji cared him in this episode. Matsushita sneaked Ayanokoji and tried to ask him to be a group, too. This guy is smart and evaluates a person appropriately.

Interesting scene was Sakayanagi talked to Ichinose and Sakayanagi was surprised when Ichinose counter argued with Sakayanagi. She is excessively confident as she usually is, but also she underestimated Ichinose. Acting and animation of this Sakayanagi's reaction are better and bigger than I originally thought, maybe because of her confidence and her original prediction.

item.title: Watching Classroom of the Elite Season 4 Episode 5
item.description:
I am a light novel reader for this series and this note includes a spoiler.

I watched the Classroom of the Elite, COTE, season 4, episode 5. I was satisfied with the scene which Yukimura got mad at Ayanokoji because of his math exam result. I thought this was skipped, but it was obviously important such that other classmates also started noticing how good Ayanokoji is.

Other than that, this episode isn't that important just watching some cute behaviors of some characters. This is the 1st episode in Season 4 that Ayanokoji and Ichinose talked and she obviously likes him and Karuizawa took care of Ayanokoji because he has a damage on his left hand. Interesting part was that he asked a question to Karuizawa whether he dates with someone who he isn't attracted to. Karuizawa didn't answer, but obviously, the answer for us is yes. He's exactly the type of person who takes advantage of whatever.

And, Amasawa also showed her card to him and it raised an eyebrow that she might be from the White room.

item.title: Watching Classroom of the Elite Season 4 Episode 4
item.description:
I am a light novel reader for this series

I watched the Classroom of the Elite, COTE, season 4, episode 4. This episode was one of the episodes I was waiting for in this season the most. Turned out that it was a little bit too fast after Ayanokoji found out what was Housen up to. I expected Horikita was more like in a panic when he got a knife in his left hand and also Sudo was almost shocked, and also they needed to take care of its bleeding. These entire reactions were removed and I felt they were too calm down even though they were just high school students in that school, except maybe Housen only. His reaction was good and maybe a director or producer thought that was enough? Also, I remembered he would say that he couldn't understand how Ayanokoji was so good before stabbing his knife, and that was one phrase I liked.

Besides, the exam showed that Ayanokoji's math score was 100 and better than anyone else, but there was no explanation how good it was, so the episode skipped a lot I felt.

Housen's fighting with Sudo and Horikita was kinda good, especially Horikita can actually fight and she could even do jump spinning kick. They still couldn't even have a chance against Housen, though. In this season, there will be more fighting scenes so maybe they'll be interested in.

item.title: Watching Classroom of the Elite Season 4 Episode 3
item.description:
I watched the Classroom of the Elite, COTE, season 4, episode 3. Karuizawa showed up at the first time in the season 4, and as she was bullied in a junior high school she was jealous maybe from anxiety and also head over kneels in love with Ayanokoji. Compared to her, he didn't change his face a bit even with her, though. Karuizawa even talked to Sato about the fact that they were dating and somehow Sato forgave Karuizawa right away. Sato was actually pretty good person without having jealous, but it was perhaps because he turned down Sato before already, so she knew there was no chance to date with him. I forgot why Sato started having a romantic feeling toward him, probably a sport festival in the 1st year, but maybe she actually has a good sense of seeing people through.

Also, Sakayanagi talked with Ayanokoji and tried to help him because she knew someone from Whiteroom came. It's cute that she was trying to help from the behind somehow.

Other than that, this episode was mostly like preparing what's going to happen next, with the discussion between Horikita's class and Housen's class in the next episode.

item.title: Watching Classroom of the Elite Season 4 Episode 2
item.description:
I watched the Classroom of the Elite, COTE, season 4, episode 2. In this episode, Horikita and Ayanokoji were trying to overcome the challenge on the next exam overall. Sakayanagi was also trying to do it by the information tactic by taking advantage of class A. What's funny was that compared to them, Ryuen and his classmates were only in a private Karaoke room and talked like he were a king, and ate a popcorn and drunk something like coke. If they're in a bar and drink a wine or wisky, maybe that matches with their characters. And I forgot how useful the 1st year will be through the end of the year and how much the assessment of Ryuen actually was useful.

Besides, Amasawa showed up at the first time in this episode, and she was really creepy woman. When I read the light novel, I guessed this girl was surely from the white room because it was so illogical of what she was doing, but also it might be just a confusing character for readers because Ayanokoji thought the same thing.

In the animation, I noticed the characters were drawn with intentional dashed or thin black lines. It is probably to avoid having clear boundaries of people by those lines because there are no such lines for real humans, but it gives me like an itchy feeling, because the line doesn't show clear distinction.

In the opening, in the previous episode, I guessed the noises on the eyes on each character might be whether they are candidates from Whiteroom or not, but in that case, Tsukishiro must not have it, and also, some 2nd year grades students also have the noises even those in the class D. Maybe these are just drawn on the scenes of Ayanokoji's views and he views most people with that view regardless of a student from the Whiteroom or not.

Ending is, what the heck. Classroom leaders do not matter in the ending, characters are from 1st year and 2nd year, and Ayanokoji is on a throne. Then there is a snake, venomous snake, I guess, and all got dead without any flesh by that venom. No idea what it meant, though. The king Ayanokoji himself is venomous and will kill everybody? Another possibility is that there is a student from the Whiteroom, but they have nothing to do with anyone but Ayanokoji.

item.title: Watching Classroom of the Elite Season 4 Episode 1
item.description:
I watched the Classroom of the Elite, COTE, season 4, episode 1. I read the light novel in 2nd year's arc.

I don't remember in the previous seasons that much, but I felt strange to hear the voice of Chabashira, and a little bit about Ikeda. It looks like Chabashira's voice actress is Jennifer Alyx, and seems hasn't been changed since season 1 so I'll get used to it.

Throughout the entire episode, it's funny to see the Housen and it's character design, considering that he is 15 or 16 years old, perhaps, as the 1st year in the high school, but he is matured in the anime level. When Ryuen just came to Housen and was trying to leave there without not doing anything was more like scenario-based story, so that the sole purpose is to show the relationship between Ryuen and Housen and how Housen is intimidating. Ryuen and Sakayanagi often do these things so I shouldn't care those things that much, though.

The ending of this season is good for both of animation and song. What the noises of eyes on each character mean? Some characters do not have like leaders in each class in the 2nd year, but many of others have. Maybe those are candidates from the whiteroom in Kiyotaka's mind. Need to double check the animation.
